scientific_metadata.spatial_approximation: Electric impulses and residuals split uniformly by recorded chord/time fraction across derived slab planes. Collision jumps belong to endpoint slab. No intra-step force localization claim; whole-window sums unchanged.
scientific_metadata.endpoint_policy: Audit last post-HS1 callback is actual, including the terminal callback. extraction_exit is an interpolated event at a different time; its delta is reported, never forced to match.
scientific_metadata.window_scope: The final accepted integrator step may extend beyond the interpolated exit plane/time. Entire raw accepted steps are audited; no claim that every final-step impulse occurred upstream of the exit plane. A zero-duration first anchor retains its actual HS1 jump; its start_post/end_pre fields both denote pre-HS1 velocity.
scientific_metadata.quadrature: Signed five-node minus three-node Simpson difference is an error indicator, not a proven bound; direct reconstruction errors are node-wise max component errors.
scientific_metadata.response: Unweighted basis integrals give fixed-realized-path d(delta_v)/dV only; no voltage division, trajectory feedback or counterfactual flight.
scientific_metadata.statistical_scope: All source IDs retained; covariance uses all audit-available IDs (including later losses), ddof=0. No outlier removal, fitting, smoothing or rescaling.
scientific_metadata.variance_growth: variance_terms.csv sums diagonal variance plus twice each unordered cross covariance; excluding initial-initial yields Var(actual_last)-Var(audit_start). Cross terms can be negative; electrode sigma alone is not a causal ranking.
scientific_metadata.claim: Attribution along realized trajectories; not an independent field-integrator or counterfactual geometry qualification.
